title: Cheaper AI Model: Cut Token Costs With 1 Setting
description:
Simple task? Don't pay for the biggest AI model. 💸

✅ Smaller models cost less per token
✅ Add a "model": "haiku" setting in .claude/settings.json
✅ Or type /model haiku in chat

Day 8 of Token Saver! Next up, Day 9: Cut Costs with Prompt Caching.
Follow for a new short every day and learn to spend fewer tokens with AI.

#shorts #ai #claudecode #aicoding #aitools #promptengineering #coding #learntocode
comment: Haiku or Sonnet: which do you pick for easy jobs? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: in Claude Code, type /model on its own to open a picker and choose a model.
